text_block_list.text: One day, as I passed near the academy's field...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, not here either after all, huh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainey! Out of the blue, but...
You wouldn't happen to know anything about wild edible plants, would you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, one of the dorm residents is feeling homesick.
I want to at least cook them some food from their hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Still, none of the wild greens I needed were in stock. I checked all sorts of greengrocers and supermarkets, too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Right, let's take the plunge and head up into the mountains!
Think of it as helping someone out and give me a hand, Trainee!"

And so, we came out to the countryside
searching for the wild vegetables we wanted, but we couldn't seem to find any.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Does it only grow deeper in the mountains?
All right, I'll go check it out!"
As we make our way up the mountain trail...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a second!
A fallen tree seems to be blocking the path!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get this junk out of the way in no time!
Stand back, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hnghh-gh-gh-gh...!
DOSSEEEEEEEI--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We're more likely to find it if we take an animal trail.
Let's go! I'll pave the way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Keep up!!
Oryaaaaah~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they grow in higher places.
Let's try climbing that cliff!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!!
I'll show you the fruits of my daily training!"

Hishi Amazon scaled the cliff face with a display of
powerful rock climbing, and then...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
I finally found it!!

By the time the sun began to set,
we had finally managed to gather the wild vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Trainy!
It's all thanks to you helping me search!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's...! The dorm student I was just talking about.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Hishiama-neesan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, tomorrow morning, I'll cook you some
food from your hometown! So cheer up!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Were you out picking
wild mountain vegetables for my sake?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Just to cook for me...!?
Even though those wild mountain greens only grow deep in the mountains...!

Even though those wild mountain greens only grow deep in the mountains...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, well, might not beat
this kid's mom's home cooking, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I've got my pride too, ya know!
I'm gonna whip up something crazy delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Hishi Ama... *sniff*...
Thank you so muuuuch...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, geez, I'm trying to cheer you up,
so don't go crying on me!!

The next morning, after eating Hishi Amazon's wild vegetable
dishes, the dorm students' homesickness was completely cured.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is nothing!
I am the dorm head of the Miho Dormitory!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: If it's for my dorm students, I'd climb any mountain, no matter how tall, and find any wild edible plant, no matter how rare!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It was pretty fun if you just think of it as a hike.
Right, Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Hishi Ama... Trainer...
*sniff*... Thank you so muuuuch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come on, stop crying!!
Cheer up already, would you?!

By the next morning, the dorm students had made a full recovery
and were eagerly asking for seconds of the wild vegetable dishes.
